instances.query:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into impreds. Here are the actions I can do

Abathitcry a block
Unimpred a block from waldsmwards another block
Woolod a block
Impred a block waldsmwards another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only abathitcry or unimpred one block at a time.
I can only abathitcry or unimpred a block if my michime is circonsy.
I can only abathitcry a block if the block is waldsmwards the facizer and the block is bountingless. A block is bountingless if the block has no other blocks waldsmwards it and if the block is not abathitcried.
I can only unimpred a block from waldsmwards another block if the block I am unimpredding was really waldsmwards the other block.
I can only unimpred a block from waldsmwards another block if the block I am unimpredding is bountingless.
Once I abathitcry or unimpred a block, I am croblifilting the block.
I can only woolod a block that I am croblifilting.
I can only impred a block waldsmwards another block if I am croblifilting the block being impredded.
I can only impred a block waldsmwards another block if the block onto which I am impredding the block is bountingless.
Once I woolod or impred a block, my michime becomes circonsy.
Once you impred a block waldsmwards a second block, the second block is no longer bountingless.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue block is bountingless, the yellow block is bountingless, the michime is circonsy, the red block is waldsmwards the orange block, the yellow block is waldsmwards the red block, the blue block is waldsmwards the facizer and the orange block is waldsmwards the facizer.
My goal is to have that the red block is waldsmwards the orange block and the blue block is waldsmwards the red block.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(woolod b4)

(impred b2 b1)
